meta.status: Curated research snapshot; not a live job-posting feed
meta.method_note: The signal score is an editorial 1–5 synthesis from the cited reports and role relevance. It is not a count of vacancies, a statistical forecast, or a probability of getting hired. Re-check sources before using the numbers in a formal report.

sources.title: World Economic Forum — Future of Jobs Report 2025
sources.finding: Employers expect AI and big data, networks and cybersecurity, and technological literacy to be among the fastest-growing skills through 2030. Economic uncertainty, AI adoption, and the green transition are also drivers of change.

sources.title: LinkedIn — Skills on the Rise: 2026
sources.finding: LinkedIn's rising-skill analysis uses year-over-year skill acquisition and hiring success. Its global summary highlights LLMs, prompt engineering, AI/ML deployment, AI business strategy, stakeholder communication, and risk/compliance themes.
sources.scope: LinkedIn member data across 12 markets; Dec 2024–Nov 2025 compared with prior year

sources.title: PayScale — Data Analyst Salary in India (2026)
sources.finding: Reported average base salary ₹577,472/year based on 2,389 salary profiles; the page also reports an entry-level total-compensation average of ₹413,462 based on 576 salaries.
sources.scope: Self-reported salary profiles; compensation definitions differ by metric

sources.title: Flexiple — Data Analyst Salary in India
sources.finding: Reports ₹5.9 lakh/year median all-level compensation and a middle-50% range of ₹4–9.3 lakh from 6,153 records.
sources.scope: Compensation records; all experience levels, India

sources.title: Flexiple — Data Engineer Salary in India
sources.finding: Reports an entry-level (0–3 years) median of ₹7.5 lakh/year and middle-50% range of ₹5–11.6 lakh from 2,179 records.

sources.title: Flexiple — Data Scientist Salary in India
sources.finding: Reports ₹14.2 lakh/year median all-level compensation and a middle-50% range of ₹7.5–26.3 lakh from 1,867 records.
sources.scope: Compensation records; all experience levels, India

sources.title: Instahyre — AI/ML Engineer Salary in India 2026
sources.finding: Reports broad fresher AI/ML engineering ranges that vary substantially by employer type and specialisation; the article gives ₹6–14 lakh/year as a broad entry-level range across its categories.
sources.scope: Instahyre's internal hiring data across 8,000+ technology roles in 2025–26; ranges vary by company type

sources.title: Instahyre — Data Scientist Salary in India 2026
sources.finding: Reports fresher data scientist ranges of roughly ₹6–10 lakh/year at many employers and higher ranges at top product firms.
sources.scope: Instahyre internal hiring data; company and role segmentation matters

sources.title: LinkedIn News India — Skills on the Rise in India
sources.finding: The India-specific summary highlights prompt engineering, LLMOps and data storytelling alongside collaboration and leadership skills.
sources.scope: India-specific LinkedIn member and hiring signal summary

skills.name: AI and Machine Learning
skills.one_line: Learn Python, statistics, evaluation, and how to test models on real data.
skills.project: Build and evaluate a model for a clearly defined problem; compare with a simple baseline and explain errors.

skills.name: Data Analysis and Storytelling
skills.one_line: Turn messy data into a decision a real person can act on.
skills.project: Analyse a public retail dataset, identify trends, and present a dashboard plus three evidence-backed recommendations.

skills.name: SQL and Database Skills
skills.2030_outlook: Useful foundation; combine with analysis or engineering
skills.one_line: Learn to retrieve, join, validate, and explain data reliably.
skills.project: Design a small database for a campus service and answer operational questions with tested SQL queries.

skills.name: Data Engineering and Pipelines
skills.2030_outlook: Important where reliable data infrastructure is needed
skills.one_line: Build reliable pipelines that move, clean, validate, and prepare data.
skills.project: Build a reproducible CSV-to-database pipeline with validation checks, logging, and a short data-quality report.

skills.name: Cybersecurity and Risk
skills.2030_outlook: Expected to rise with digitalisation and risk complexity
skills.one_line: Understand systems, threats, access control, and how to reduce risk.
skills.project: Create a threat model for a fictional campus app and prioritise mitigations; use only safe, authorised lab exercises.

skills.name: LLMs and Generative AI
skills.2030_outlook: Opportunity is real, but tools and job requirements may shift quickly
skills.one_line: Build useful AI applications and test accuracy, cost, privacy, and failure modes.
skills.project: Create a small retrieval-based question-answering tool over public documents and test it against questions with known answers.

skills.name: Statistics and Experimentation
skills.2030_outlook: More useful when paired with domain knowledge and data tools
skills.one_line: Reason about uncertainty, evidence, experiments, and misleading patterns.
skills.project: Analyse an experiment dataset, estimate uncertainty, and explain what the data can and cannot prove.

skills.name: Cloud and MLOps
skills.2030_outlook: Useful as models and data products move into production
skills.one_line: Take a working project from a notebook into a repeatable, monitored service.
skills.project: Package a small model behind an API and document tests, versions, monitoring and rollback.

skills.name: Programming Fundamentals
skills.2030_outlook: Stays valuable when paired with problem solving and software delivery
skills.one_line: Write readable code, test assumptions, debug, and explain trade-offs.
skills.project: Build a command-line tool with input validation, tests, a README, and a Git history.

skills.name: Communication and Data Storytelling
skills.2030_outlook: Human skills remain valuable alongside technical capability
skills.one_line: Explain a technical result, its limits, and what someone should do next.
skills.project: Present one analysis in a 3-minute briefing with a chart, caveats, and a clear recommendation.

skills.name: Green and Energy Data
skills.2030_outlook: Potential growth linked to energy and climate transitions; roles vary by sector
skills.one_line: Apply data skills to energy, emissions, and sustainability questions.
skills.project: Analyse public energy or emissions data and state the limits of comparisons across regions.

roles.name: Data Analyst / BI Analyst
roles.experience: All experience levels; market median, not a fresher guarantee
roles.caveat: All-level median and range: do not read these as fresher-only pay. PayScale reports ₹4.13 L average total compensation for under one year, based on 576 salaries; that is a separate measure.

roles.name: Data Engineer
roles.caveat: Compensation-record dataset; individual outcomes vary by company, city, skills and experience. This is not a rate paid for learning a skill.

roles.name: Data Scientist
roles.experience: All experience levels; market median, not a fresher guarantee
roles.caveat: All-level data, so it includes experienced professionals; fresher compensation can be substantially lower. Instahyre reports roughly ₹6–10 LPA for freshers at many employers.

roles.name: AI / ML Engineer
roles.experience: Broad entry-level range; varies sharply by employer type
roles.caveat: This range spans employer types; the highest offers are not typical or guaranteed. Production-quality projects, fundamentals, and interview performance matter.

economic_shifts.title: AI adoption and information processing
economic_shifts.student_meaning: Learn to use AI tools, but build foundations in data, evaluation, verification, and deployment.

economic_shifts.title: Economic uncertainty and changing hiring
economic_shifts.signal: Employers expect business models and workforce needs to shift
economic_shifts.student_meaning: Prefer transferable foundations and a portfolio of real outcomes over chasing one short-lived tool.

economic_shifts.title: Cybersecurity, governance and compliance
economic_shifts.student_meaning: Learn privacy, secure systems, data governance and responsible AI alongside technical skills.

economic_shifts.title: Energy and climate transition
economic_shifts.signal: Sector-linked roles and skill needs expected to evolve
economic_shifts.student_meaning: Domain knowledge can differentiate an AI & DS student; explore energy, climate, healthcare and finance datasets.
